title_vi: Bộ nhớ đệm hỏng theo những kiểu nào

related.reason_vi: Bài riêng về truy vấn khóa không tồn tại, cất giá trị rỗng và bộ lọc Bloom.
Khởi động nguội và hạn sống là các điều cần cân nhắc khi dùng bộ nhớ đệm.

claims.evidence: MDN's caching guide, Redis's SET command page and Microsoft's Circuit Breaker pattern read from local clones; a hot-key stampede and TTL jitter tested on Redis 7.0.15.

claims.claim_vi: Request collapse: when identical requests arrive at a shared cache at the same time, it forwards a single request to the origin and reuses the result for all clients.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content at commit a1aa79c09717761fc72c20bac94bb9c430ed487a, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: SET with NX only sets a key that does not exist and PX sets an expiry in milliseconds; SET resource NX EX max-lock-time is a simple lock, improved by a random token and deleting only when the value matches; the Redlock algorithm is preferred for better guarantees.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of redis/docs at commit 3b030c7ef066c0bb7f88ddec02c784e49783b0f8, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: Circuit Breaker: temporarily block access to a remote service after failures reach a threshold instead of retrying, letting it recover and improving stability.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: Hot key just expired, 50 concurrent requests, database stub sleeping 200 ms, 10 trials each: no protection 50 DB calls every trial (slowest 205-210 ms); SET NX PX 2000 lock 1 call in 6 trials and 2 in 4 (slowest 211-403 ms); lock plus re-reading the cache after acquiring 1 call in all 10 (slowest 213-216 ms). 10,000 keys with TTL 3600 expire within one minute; with 0-599 s of random extra they spread over 11 minutes, at most 1,042 in one minute.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one KVM virtual machine (4 vCPU): Python threads with one raw RESP connection each against Redis 7.0.15; remaining TTLs read back with TTL.

claims.claim_vi: Four ways caches go wrong: thunder herd (many keys expiring at once; random expiry, protect core data), cache penetration (null value, Bloom filter), cache breakdown (hot key expiring; the source says hot keys take 80% of queries and suggests no expiry), cache crash (circuit breaker, cache cluster).
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung ghi chú: bốn kiểu hỏng, thử khóa nóng hết hạn, và hạn sống lệch nhau. Kiểu khóa không tồn tại chỉ nhắc qua vì có bài riêng.
source_deviations: Source's figure that hot keys take 80% of queries is dropped: no source.
Source describes a circuit breaker as stopping services from visiting both the cache and the database; the lesson uses Microsoft's pattern definition instead.
The lesson adds a stampede experiment that finds a gap in the simple lock (two loads) and the re-read that closes it.
